# PaperTrade instructions

Use docs/SPEC.md and ACCEPTANCE.md. Execute only the selected phase. Reuse saved phase outputs. Python 3.12, FastAPI, Uvicorn, SQLite and local HTML/CSS/JS with Canvas. Keep data files unchanged. Inspect CSVs with scripts that print counts, ranges and failures. Keep chat output to changed files, checks and blockers. Work locally and avoid live feeds, CDN assets and Node tooling.
